title: PRD typed hook contract (hook_event.v1/hook_result.v1) + 6 missing hook events
objective: PRD §18: hooks are shell scripts, not the typed handoff.hook_event.v1 / handoff.hook_result.v1 gate contract (payload + severity + required_actions). And 6 of 12 required hook events are absent from hooks.toml: SessionResume, PreCommand, PostCommand, PreTest, PostTest, PostHandoff. Build the typed hook runner + add the missing events so lifecycle gating is a typed contract, not stringly-typed shell.
acceptance_criteria: PRD typed hook contract (hook_event.v1/hook_result.v1) + 6 missing hook events: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
